Expected make probability of every shot

Source: R/shotmaking.R
expected_fg.Rd

A league-wide model of how likely a shot from a given spot is to go in. With mgcv installed this is a logistic GAM with a smooth of distance and angle per league and shot value; otherwise a binned average (0.5 m distance bands by zone). Extra context columns (shot clock, score margin) can be added as extra smooth terms, which is the regression version of a classification-tree "high-pressure" model (see pressure_effects()).

Usage

expected_fg(shots, extra = NULL, method = c("gam", "bins"))

Arguments

shots

Shots with x, y, made (and optionally value, league).

extra

Optional character vector of extra numeric columns to adjust for (each enters as a smooth).

method

"gam" or "bins".

Value

shots with a column xfg.
